rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual way to describe laboured breathing; it does not by itself imply a whistling sound.

example.english: I wheeze badly after climbing the stairs.
example.traditional: 我行完樓梯喘氣喘得好勁。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hang4 jyun4 lau4 tai1 cyun2 hei3 cyun2 dak1 hou2 ging6

rows.traditional: A + 呼吸 + 有 + 喘鳴聲
rows.jyutping: A fu1 kap1 jau5 cyun2 ming4 sing1
rows.note: Use this when the audible wheezing itself needs to be stated, especially in a clinical context.

example.english: The doctor says they wheeze when they breathe.
example.traditional: 醫生話佢呼吸有喘鳴聲。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 fu1 kap1 jau5 cyun2 ming4 seng1

rows.note: Use this when someone laughs so intensely that they become breathless.

example.english: That joke made me wheeze with laughter.
example.traditional: 佢講嗰個笑話，搞到我笑到喘晒氣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 go2 go3 siu3 waa2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 siu3 dou3 cyun2 saai3 hei3
